title: Grilled Salmon Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish perfect for a quick dinner. The combination of Norwegian salmon and jubilant seasonings creates a delightful taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (400°F/200°C).
Thread the salmon pieces onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together the jubilant seasoning, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the salmon.
Grill the salmon skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Remove from heat and let rest for 2-3 minutes.
